scientific_integrity: The stated proofs are analytic; exact symbolic checks support finite algebra only. No independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact driftless symmetric Brownian motion with iid Poisson reset multipliers bounded strictly inside the unit interval; no finite-sample inference, robustness, or unbounded multipliers. Generic polynomial correlation methods cover some computational ingredients. Research priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: Hidden reset reflection and moment-rate tomography for contractive Brownian jumps
